|translation='''Title:''' The First Transport Is Away!.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any system except Hoth. Target any Medium Transport at a Hoth location. When the target reaches this Utinni Effect, retrieve X Force. X is twice the number of passengers. Relocate the Utinni Effect to the Hoth system. Your total power is +2 in battles at Hoth location cards.

'''Lore:'''
Once you have passed through the energy shield, proceed straight to the rendezvous point. All right? I'm wishing you luck.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The power bonus is at ホスの位置カード, not “Hoth sites.” Lore uses いいわね？ instead of “Understood?”
